description: Before writing or changing code that calls a third-party API, send the calls (URL, method, models, parameters, version headers, SDK) and get each one's status (broken, at_risk, redirected, deprecated, ok, unknown) with the breaking changes that hit it: what breaks, when, what to migrate to, the provider's source. Works without a key (25 calls, the changes providers announced); a free key adds the ones Okapi inferred and 100 calls a request.

headers.description: Every version header the call sends, name and literal value; {} when it sends none, so the changes for calls without one apply. Left out, Okapi cannot tell. Never a secret.

method.description: The HTTP method, when the code names one.

models.description: Model ids the call may send.

params.description: Parameter names it sends; dot paths for nested ones.

url.description: The URL the code calls; templates welcome: https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}

name: check_calls

notice.description: Without a key: how many more changes a free key would show.

title: Check API calls
